cli.skills_push.stale_base.role: lop skills push CLI output: why a push was refused
cli.skills_push.stale_base.note: head and base are opaque hub revision tokens (keep verbatim). 'push baseline' = the hub revision this machine last published or integrated.

cli.skills_push.stale_base_next.role: lop skills push CLI output: the safe next step after a stale-base refusal
cli.skills_push.stale_base_next.note: head is an opaque revision token; name is the skill name. Commands in backticks are literal and must not be translated.

cli.skills_push.stale_base_bundle_next.role: lop skills push CLI output: next step for a bundle skill whose hub tree moved
cli.skills_push.stale_base_bundle_next.note: name is the skill name; backticked commands are literal. 'tree' = the bundle's file tree.

cli.skills_push.merge_refused_next.role: lop skills push CLI output: the safe next step after a refused merge
cli.skills_push.merge_refused_next.tone: instructional, concise; the last sentence is a warning
cli.skills_push.merge_refused_next.note: head is either empty or ' ' + an opaque revision token, appended directly after 'hub head'; name is the skill name; backticked commands are literal.

cli.skills_push.verified.role: lop skills push CLI output after a successful publication
cli.skills_push.verified.note: revision is an opaque hub revision token.

cli.skills_push.verify_mismatch.role: lop skills push CLI warning: the hub holds something other than what was sent
cli.skills_push.verify_mismatch.note: revision is an opaque token; name is the skill name; backticked command is literal.

cli.skills_push.verify_unavailable.role: lop skills push CLI output: post-push verification could not run
cli.skills_push.verify_unavailable.note: reason is a short technical code (English); name is the skill name; backticked command is literal.
